name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, with an initial career in auditing for multinational corporations. His meticulous nature and sharp analytical skills quickly propelled him through the ranks. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Ricardo saw an opportunity to combine his professional expertise with his passion when a finance position opened at a Formula 3 team in Brazil. He quickly adapted to the fast-paced environment, mastering the intricacies of motorsport finance and demonstrating an exceptional ability to manage complex budgets and financial risks.

Joining Mercedes-AMG was a pivotal moment in Ricardo's career. He's known for his data-driven approach, ensuring that every financial decision aligns with the team's strategic goals. He's a master of efficiency, always seeking ways to optimize resource allocation and maximize the team's financial performance. Ricardo's pragmatic nature allows him to remain calm and collected under pressure, making him an invaluable asset to the team during crucial moments. His experience and attention to detail make him a reliable and respected figure within the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a serious demeanor and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down financial observations.
Insists on using a specific brand of green ink pen.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
